title: U.S. Geological Survey Pollinator Science Strategy, 2025–35—A Review and Look Forward
abstract: This “U.S. Geological Survey Pollinator Science Strategy, 2025–35—A Review and Look Forward” (“Pollinator Science Strategy”) describes the science vision of the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) to support management, conservation, and policy decisions on animal pollinators and their habitats.
